image.prompt:
Straight-on ELEVATION photograph of one whole high-rise building, taken from very far away with a long telephoto lens: the camera is level with the building's mid-height, so every vertical edge is perfectly vertical and parallel with no keystone convergence, and the main facade is seen frontally with only a thin sliver of one side. Not a three-quarter view, not an aerial view, not looking up from the street.

The building: Thirty-storey commercial tower with a plain dark grey glass curtain wall on every floor, narrow pale concrete spandrel bands between floors, a rooftop steel frame carrying a large generic lit sign of Thai lettering, and a busy multi-level ground floor with a covered walkway Materials: dark grey tinted glass, pale grey concrete spandrels, black painted steel sign frame with red and white lit lettering, grey concrete walkway.

Whole building: the complete tower from its ground-floor base to the very top of its crown, roof plant, spire or antenna, with nothing cropped. The base sits at the bottom of the silhouette with nothing in front of it: no trees, no street, no cars, no people, no neighbouring buildings, no scaffolding. The only text is lettering explicitly described above; otherwise no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no annotations.

Framing: the building is centred and fills about 85% of the frame along its longer axis, with a clear empty margin on every side.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080) fills every part of the frame that is not the building, including where the sky would be and where the ground would be. The building is a cut-out floating against an infinite flat backdrop. No sky, no clouds, no horizon, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient, no haze, no atmospheric fade.

Lighting: bright overcast daylight, flat and even, soft and shadowless, so the facade reads as true albedo with its glass tint, concrete and paint colours exactly as described. No sun glare, no specular blowout, no lens flare, no dramatic sky colour reflected in the glass.

One building only. Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, every floor, window, mullion and balcony resolved, realistic weathering and grime. Not stylised, not cartoon, not a 3D render, not a wireframe, not low-poly.

license.notice: Fully synthetic. No third-party scanned or scraped geometry.

name: Rooftop-Sign Commercial Tower
nameTh: ตึกป้ายโฆษณาดาดฟ้า
notes: The batch's rooftop-sign tower: a plain dark-glass commercial slab whose only advertising is the lit Thai lettering on the roof frame. An earlier version wrapped the lower fifteen floors in an LED billboard showing abstract gradients; the wrap was removed on 2026-08-27 because the generated panel read as a smeared colour blob and looked bad, so the prompt now describes glass and spandrels the whole way up. The rooftop lettering must be generic Thai, not a company name. Skyline imposter, not a building model: the deliverable is ONE upright quad (2 triangles, 1 draw call, 1 material, 1 geometry) carrying this asset's plate as its texture with the flat grey backdrop keyed to alpha, placed 150-300 m out beyond the playable area and yawed each frame to face the camera. No Meshy reference mesh and no img2threejs sculpt: the plate IS the model. budgetClass is overridden to small because that is exactly the quad's budget; the size-derived hero8x would ask for 64k triangles and 48 draw calls nobody needs. collider none because nothing in play can reach it. Depth is declared 0.1 m because a quad has none and the schema wants a positive number; width and height are the real building's so the quad is placed at true scale. Plate: style profile thai-skyline-imposter-v1 (straight-on telephoto elevation, whole building, flat grey where sky and ground would be), generated with fal-ai/nano-banana-2 at resolution 2K in aspect_ratio 9:16, chosen as the narrowest supported ratio still wider than the declared w:h. The RAW 2K output is the texture and must be kept beside the asset as assets/<id>/imposter.png; assets/<id>/preview.jpg is the 1024-square registry plate only. The id keeps its original led-wrapped slug because ids are immutable folder names. Forms are generic Bangkok archetypes, not any named landmark or brand. Plate seed 103: the model framed the base at row 2673 of 2752, inside prepare-image's bottom-5% shadow band, and the gate reported a 17% contact shadow; the rows under the base measured flat backdrop (luma 133 +/-2 at y>=2680, min 131), so the raw was extended 10% top and bottom with the measured backdrop (134,134,134) and passed the gate at 0% shadow, 1 component, 39% coverage. imposter.png is that padded raw at 1536x3302.
